# Docs Memory

## Use For
- Durable documentation preferences for issue closeout docs, READMEs, and deeper notes.
- Recurring structure, tone, and scope corrections that should shape future doc work.
- Stable rules about what belongs in READMEs versus issue docs versus deeper notes.

## Do Not Include
- Full rendered docs, copied README sections, or long prose examples.
- One-time wording tweaks that only matter for a single issue.
- Implementation details that belong in code comments, issue docs, or deeper notes instead.
- Secrets, credentials, or unpublished product information.

## Notes
- Keep docs grounded in repo evidence and prefer linking to existing docs over duplicating long explanations.
